scenes.say: Down money and want to win it back? That feeling is the fastest road to zero.
Money already lost is a sunk cost. It's gone no matter what you do next.
Two groups play a slightly losing game, win {a_p}. One bets flat. One bets bigger to win back losses.
The chasers do get back to even more often.
But {b_ruin} of them go broke, versus {a_ruin} of flat bettors.
Winning it back a few times feels like a strategy. One wipeout erases all of it.
Decide on what's ahead of you, never on what you've already lost.

takeaway: Decide on what's ahead of you, never on what you've already lost.
